objects: one independently represented printed Extort instance
the trigger controller and active opponents
events: completed spell cast by the source controller
state_reads: actual resolved loss returned by the canonical life batch
costs: one white or black mana per accepted instance; decline has no effect
timing: the loss instruction completes before gain begins
triggers caused by loss do not resolve between the two instructions
choices: one independent scalar payment per trigger
hidden_information: payment belongs only to the trigger controller; life totals remain public
apnap: normal cast trigger placement and controller trigger-order choices
layers: source ability applicability uses current typed fragments
replacement_effects: actual total loss is computed after loss replacements
gain replacements resume after the prior loss remains committed
copy: copied triggers retain their locked controller and independently choose payment
control_change: a queued trigger does not change controller when the source changes control
zone_change: a queued trigger remains after the source leaves the battlefield
source_leaves: payment and loss do not require the source to remain in its original zone

implementation.supported_slice: Ordinary printed Extort instances with independently closed whole-card siblings and canonical hybrid payment and life transactions.

known_blockers: unrepresented outer Extort grants and copied/text-changed keyword producers need separate typed contracts
independently unsupported result or static siblings prevent whole-card admission
external unrepresented life-prohibition producers remain unsupported
